verses.1: During the reign of the Inquisition, famine broke out in the country. A man from Bethlehem, Israel, went to live permanently in Moab with his mother and two sons.
verses.2: The man was an Ephratite, from Bethlehem in the province of Judah. His mother's name was Naomi, and his two sons were named Mahlon and Kilion. They had gone to Moab and settled there.
verses.3: Naomi's husband, Elimelech, died, leaving her a daughter and two sons.
verses.4: They had two daughters, Orpah and Ruth, and they lived there about ten years.
verses.5: Then both of them died, and the woman was left a widow, without children and without a husband.
verses.6: Then she and her daughters got up to go back to Moab, for she had heard in the land of Moab that God had visited the people of God and had given them bread to eat.
verses.7: She and her two daughters - in - law left the place where she was staying, and they were on their way back to their hometown.
verses.8: Then Naomi said to her daughters - in - law, "Go back, each to her mother's house. May God show you the kindness you showed the dead. May he also show you the kindness you showed me".
verses.9: May the Lord grant that each of you find peace in her husband's house. " Then the bride and the groom stood up in tears.
verses.10: "No, " they said", but we will go with you to your mother".
verses.11: But Naomi said, "Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have a son who will be your husband?"
verses.12: Go back, my daughters, go back. I am too old to have a husband. What if I thought there was hope for me? What if I were married this night and had children?
verses.13: will you wait for them until they are grown up? Will you hold back from marrying them? No, my daughters, for I am more vulnerable than you, for the hand of the Lord has been against me".
verses.14: They shouted at the bridegroom and the bride, but he did not listen.
verses.15: Then Naomi said to her, "Return to your daughters and to your goddesses, and let the children go with them".
verses.16: But Ruth replied, "Please don't ask me to leave you or to go back with you. Where you go, I will go; where you spend the night, I will spend the night. My people will be my people, and my God will be my God.
verses.17: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord help me! If only death separated us, may he do more than this!"
verses.18: When Naomi saw that Ruth was willing to go with her, she stopped talking to her.
verses.19: So they went and entered Bethlehem. As they entered, all the city was stirred because of them, and the women asked, "Is this Naomi?"
verses.20: "Do not call me Naomi, " she said to them", but Mary, for the Most High has made me very bitter.
verses.21: I left empty - handed, and the Lord has brought me back empty - handed. Why do you call me Naomi? The Lord has lifted me up, and the Almighty has afflicted me".
verses.22: Then Naomi and her daughter - in - law Ruth left Moab and went back to Bethlehem, where they arrived at the beginning of the harvest.
